title: One table from Open my stall to the rush (flow A)
problem: The bell shows a list of rows and then swaps to the round table for the rush; the owner finds the jump jarring.
scope: After Open my stall the crates go to their seats round the table; rival crates shut, with a black square for each piece out, filling or ready
Pricing on a sheet at the bottom with the table in view above it
The bell rung in the middle; crates open one by one clockwise from yours
Favoured Trade asked in the middle of the table (yours, or a rival deciding)
The first customer comes in and the rush continues at the same table; the bell list removed
Online, pass-and-play hand-over, reduced motion, 2 to 6 stalls at 390x844 and 360x640
exclusions: Any rule, number, save or message change
The takings, the evening and the night

acceptance.text: npm run test:e2e passes; the online leak check stays 0
Nothing secret before the bell: a rival crate shows only its count; on a shared phone the hand-over hides your crate
Seen by me beside mock-up A at 390x844 and 360x640 with 2, 4 and 6 stalls, with and without a tie

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-13, after the three animated flows: "three crate flow should be A, but players need to know how many fruits are up for sale for each crate, add a black square per fruit to indicate this (like design c)".
